text: Dans ce match très animé, Seabrook Town s'impose 4-2 face à Harbour City grâce à une tactique offensive dynamique et un pressing plus intense en seconde période [#1361]. Malheureusement pour Harbour City, malgré un bon début avec un jeu de passes longues et patientes qui a mené à des buts d'Elias Okafor et Marek Barros [#905] [#975], ils n'ont pas tenu face à la domination de Seabrook, qui a eu 53,4% de possession et a tiré 22 fois contre 10 pour Harbour City. Kian Romano a été le héros avec deux buts en toute fin de match, chanceuses comme leur xG élevés à 0.605 et 0.952, soit des occasions très probables de but [#1882] [#1906]. Marek Barros, malgré sa performance incroyable avec 1 but, 2 passes décisives et 9 interceptions, n'a pas pu empêcher la défaite de son équipe. Ce fut un match riche en intensité, avec beaucoup d'actions et un changement stratégique clé qui a tourné la partie en faveur de Seabrook Town.

trace.output: Brief: full-match recap for fan audience in fr

- Seabrook Town scored 4 goals with a total xG of 3.44, outperforming Harbour City's 2 goals with a total xG of 1.03 [#905, #975, #1104, #1448, #1882, #1906].
- Harbour City had fewer shots (10) and shots on target (5) compared to Seabrook Town's 22 shots and 9 on target [#team_stats].
- Seabrook Town maintained higher possession (53.4%) and field tilt (57.7%) throughout the match [#team_stats].
- Kian Romano scored two late goals at 90+2' and 90+3' with high xG values (0.605 and 0.952), turning the game in Seabrook Town's favor [#1882, #1906].
- Marek Barros was player of the match with 1 goal, 2 assists, 9 interceptions, and a rating of 9.8, despite his team losing [#player_of_the_match].

- Seabrook Town's second-half tactical change to press higher and play more direct (increasing press intensity from 0.66 to 0.84 and directness from 0.42 to 0.57) reflects a shift to a more aggressive approach while chasing the game; this enabled regains close to the opponent’s goal leading directly to goals by Tariq Marlowe and Callum Varga from quick transitions after turnovers [1361][1104][1448].

- The opening goal for Harbour City was a product of patient build-up passing (17 passes over 56.9 seconds) typical of their 4-2-3-1 formation and "patient short passing" style, culminating in a through ball assist from Marek Barros to Elias Okafor, demonstrating controlled possession to break down Seabrook’s 3-4-3 defensive shape [905].

- Seabrook Town’s successful late counter-attack goal at 90+2’ by Kian Romano shows how their 3-4-3 formation enabled a quick break with only 2 passes after regaining possession, exploiting Harbour City's transition vulnerability as they chased the game and adjusted to higher pressing, which left spaces behind their defense [1882].

- Marek Barros’s early second goal for Harbour City came from a cross originating from a corner, leveraging their set-piece advantage (6 corners in the first half), which highlights their effective use of overloads and wide delivery from a typically patient build-up tactic, contrasting with Seabrook's emphasis on wide crossing play during open play phases [975].
